title: Applying the double angle formula for cosine
text: Recall the double angle formula for cosine. There are three forms: cos(2alpha) $$=$$ $$cos^2\left(\alpha\right)$$ - $$sin^2\left(\alpha\right)$$, cos(2alpha) $$=$$ $$1$$ - $$2sin^2\left(\alpha\right)$$, or cos(2alpha) $$=$$ $$2cos^2\left(\alpha\right)$$ - $$1$$.

title: Identify sin(alpha) and cos(alpha)
text: If sin(alpha) $$=$$ $$\frac{3}{5}$$ and cos(alpha) $$=$$ $$\frac{4}{5}$$, what is $$cos^2\left(\alpha\right)$$ - $$sin^2\left(\alpha\right)$$?
